title: WhatsApp Desktop message store
whyItMatters: WhatsApp keeps a local copy of chats, contacts, sent photos and files. Anyone who takes the disk can see who the person talked to, even without the phone.
source: MSIX packaged apps keep user data in Packages/<PackageFamilyName>/LocalState: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/api/windows.storage.applicationdata.localfolder
notes: Microsoft Store build; the wildcard covers the publisher hash of the package family name (commonly 5319275A.WhatsAppDesktop_cv1g1gvanyjgm, but it can differ between builds). The older Electron WhatsApp Desktop kept data under %APPDATA% WhatsApp instead. Message database and media are encrypted by the app.
